notes.title: Update 2.0.3
notes.content:
The new [b]Overtime[/b] chapter is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2262610/view/606402352818161334]here[/url]! It's new full-length chapter that continues the story of Penny and her friends!

Update 2.0.3

[*] Removes the hard cap for logs collected in Lumber Lass Fever
- This is implemented by way of a "prestige" system.
- When the big number that was the old cap is reached, all logs collected will be consumed to increment a "star" level. This repeats if/when the big number is reached again.
- Nothing else happens, but at least the numbers will continue to go up.
- You really don't have to try it for yourself. There's no achievement for it.
[*]Fixes for typos, formatting errors, and small bugs
[*](Just FYI) Where's 2.0.2? We skipped it on Steam because it only had bug fixes for a non-Steam build

Anyway, thanks for playing and for all your love and support!!

notes.title: Overtime!
notes.content:
First, thank you to everyone who has already bought and loved Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines. This new update is for you. Really, I can't thank you enough.

It took a while, but it's done! A whole new extra bonus chapter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/fc9f971fd9bf5d44a3e03df66bae2ad18b3509fd.png[/img]

And it's available now, for everyone who already owns Dreams and Deadlines! For free! Update the game, and you should see the new "Overtime" chapter on the title screen. The story takes place a year after the "True Ending" of Dreams and Deadlines, and if the game can't detect whether you've already seen it (achievement: "A Bright Future?"), it'll warn you that you should probably do that first, but it also won't stop you if you want to play the new chapter anyway. 

[h3]New Stuff in the Overtime Update![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/a577cf9690f8d6a1fbbf0d63fbc42d276a16dfdf.png[/img]
[*] An entirely new full-length chapter, continuing Penny's story after the events of Dreams and Deadlines! It's like, longer than the original game! It basically doubles the total game size! A real bonus, as they say.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/164c7c3d4615a672152bceb97c03c51c31cce06b.png[/img]
[*] More CG artworks than the original game. I drew a lot of new pictures! Ow, my hand hurts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/8a62db381f6131d1c56aca2dd01c83cb0c46d9d1.png[/img]
[*] 26 new achievements! Behold the consequences of your actions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/432c99358cd414edf07b6347a7b371f81adbecbf.png[/img]
[*] A new achievement gallery! Keep track of all the achievements you've unlocked, each with a cool piece of artwork.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/bb40046cbe84cc135d08072e1c79086eca403c92.png[/img]
[*] Lumber Lass Fever! It's Lumber Lass, but with a "Fever" button!

[*] And of course, more music from the amazing and illustrious [url=https://chancethrash.bandcamp.com/album/endless-monday-dreams-and-deadlines-ost]Chance Thrash[/url].

And so on. Anyway, I really hope you enjoy the new chapter as much as I enjoyed making it. If you find any weird bugs or issues, please feel free to post in the bug report forum or email me at my support address. And if you enjoy the new chapter and want more, please follow my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/hcnone/]dev page[/url] on Steam or my social medias so you can stay tuned for whatever's next in the Endless Monday Video Game Universe. Thank you again!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/073d3d423e3bac77c66c1b4156b71472a731d119.png[/img]

notes.title: Happy New Year 2025!! And Some Announcements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/81a4ba53a9dc5d59235176e8a4b97eb6019c971b.png[/img]

Well, another year has passed, and it's 2025 now. Hope you had a good year. I've been busy!

We released Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines in three more languages. I'm happy the game has been so loved around the world.

You might remember that I said I was hoping to release a free content update in 2024, but after working hard on it for most of the year (with lots of other responsibilities throughout), it turns out it would take just a little longer... 

[h2]Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines and Overtime[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/0bdc33e1c9809fe6fc54391a60b4701516f43c86.png[/img]
But... I'm happy to announce it's almost done! [b]Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines and Overtime[/b] is the next chapter of Penny's story, and will be available for [b]free[/b] to everyone who already owns a copy of the game. All the text is written and is now undergoing localization for all currently supported languages, while I finish up the remaining art assets and code (and there are a lot of new art assets I need to draw.). I'm expecting the update to be ready for release in [b]February[/b]. Or thereabouts. Okay, definitely sometime in March, though.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/40c9b13637a3e0425297d8b7ce2405662e74de99.png[/img]
The story continues one year after the events of Dreams and Deadlines, and is about the same length as the first chapter (wow!). If you haven't gotten the (true) ending yet, you'll probably want to get that before playing the new chapter. And of course, there will be new features like a bonus gallery and new achievements (20+ more)! I'll avoid talking much more about it so as to avoid ~Spoilers~. But I hope you enjoy playing it as much as I did making it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/164c7c3d4615a672152bceb97c03c51c31cce06b.png[/img]
So yeah! Please look forward to the continued adventures of Penny and her friends, back at the office. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/a577cf9690f8d6a1fbbf0d63fbc42d276a16dfdf.png[/img] 
Or not.

[h2]Other stuff[/h2]

After the Overtime Update, I'm going to start diving deep into Game 2! That's right! The second game. I need to make more game to sell so I can keep making more game, after all. As they say. So, expect to see some updates about that in 2025, too. 

And of course, here's a [url=https://chancethrash.bandcamp.com/album/endless-monday-dreams-and-deadlines-ost]link to Chance Thrash's luxurious OST for the game[/url]. Chance has also graciously provided some great new tracks for the Overtime Update.

Thank you playing, and I hope you stick around for more adventures in the Endless Monday Video Game Universe! And I hope you have a wonderful 2025!!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/dd9dd3885956f7f01a670e768a3ca4c9a85522c1.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2262610/Endless_Monday_Dreams_and_Deadlines/

notes.title: Update 1.0.11: More Localizations

Update 1.0.11: More Localizations:

[*] New! You can now play the game in 简体中文 and Português-Brasil! You can select the desired language from the language selection menu on the title screen.
[*] Not new, but 日本語 and 한국어 localizations are available too!
[*] Fixed! Linux build achievements should work again.
[/list]

Hotfix 1.0.11a ("publicbeta" branch only):

[list]
[*] Refactored UI animation code which should fix instances of weird slowdowns when opening phone, choice menus, or various other settings screens
[*] Fixed a missing S.Chinese font glyph in a particular cutscene
[/list]

Update 2024-03-31: 1.0.11a may have introduced a rare crash bug, so the live build has been rolled back to 1.0.11. If you are affected by the issues fixed in 1.0.11a, you can still play the new build on the "publicbeta" beta branch. If you encounter any crash bugs, please let me know with details (including OS and language) at gamesupport@endlessmonday.com. Thank you!

notes.title: Overwhelmingly Positive! Thank you!
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you!![/h2]

We have just hit the big Steam milestone of 500 user reviews, and with it, an "[b]Overwhelmingly Positive[/b]" rating! And... as of this writing, we're sitting at [b]100% positive[/b] reviews?!! I can't thank you enough for enjoying this game. Especially because it was my first game ever, and meant a lot to me personally, I truly am overwhelmed at the response. Thank you, thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/dd9dd3885956f7f01a670e768a3ca4c9a85522c1.png[/img]

Thanks to your love and support, I'm busy working on future installments in the Endless Monday Game Universe! I hope you stick around for more adventures at the Endless Monday office (and beyond).

PS: If you don't have the game yet, you can check it out below, if you want. It's on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2262610/Endless_Monday_Dreams_and_Deadlines/

Also, if you have played it and enjoyed the amazing music stylings of [url=https://chancethrash.bandcamp.com/]Chance Thrash[/url]'s OST, you can find it on Bandcamp, [url=https://chancethrash.bandcamp.com/album/endless-monday-dreams-and-deadlines-ost]here[/url]!!

Thank you, again! And again! x500 times!

notes.title: Now available on Mac!
notes.content:
Hello again! Thank you for playing ENDLESS MONDAY: DREAMS AND DEADLINES! Can you believe it's already been a month since the game launched? I've really been so happy with how many of you have played and enjoyed the game. Thank you thank you!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/87babdb618af6e3bbbf9231494d9b8190167fcc0.png[/img]
If you've been waiting for the Mac release to play ENDLESS MONDAY: DREAMS AND DEADLINES, well I have good news for you! It's now available! On Mac! Why not install it on your work laptop and go on an adventure on the company dime? (Hint: Press the T key while in-game if your boss is nearby). This release also comes with a bunch of other smaller changes and features, so check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2262610/view/3694687365033020284?l=english]patch notes for 1.0.7[/url] if you're interested in that. 

This update involved some under the hood changes for future updates, so please let me know if you run into any weird issues you weren't seeing before.

[h2]Other Stuff[/h2]
JP Localization is well under way! I've also made a lot of code changes under the hood to allow for translations to other languages, so that should be coming soon.

Check out the[url=https://chancethrash.bandcamp.com/album/endless-monday-dreams-and-deadlines-ost] OST on Chance Thrash's bandcamp[/url], why don't ya.

Stickers merch for Endless Monday is available on [url=https://shop.hcnone.com]my shop[/url]! You know, in case you wanted to support the game and stick some cool stickers on your precious items while you're at it.

notes.title: Trading Cards and Other Updates
notes.content:
Hello again! Thank you for playing [b]Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines[/b]! I have a few updates for you this fine Thursday afternoon.

[h1]Trading cards[/h1]

Profile stuff is now live! You can now collect trading cards and turn them into badges and get profile backgrounds and emoticons. I put Skye and Penny on my own profile! Ain't that something? From what they're telling me you will receive cards retroactively for the playtime you've already put in to the game, so a lot of you should already see some cards in your inventory...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/cd94dd4ff11c706a3fd76df5ae773db7d453697d.png[/img]
[i]Above: Trading cards![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/dbb6a65a5770f4f80e779d2b476a3653dade1748.png[/img]
[i]Above: Your profile will probably be less empty than my test profile! But just look at Skye and Penny![/i]


I think it's pretty cool. I hope you like it too. 

[h1]Other Stuff[/h1]

In addition to making profile backgrounds and emoticons, I've been hard at work trying to get a Mac build ready for release. It's mostly done, but I'm working through a few bugs that should be squashed soon. I'm also adding a windowed fullscreen mode (whoa). Both of these involved a bit of under-the-hood changes to the game code, so I'm also testing that there aren't any issues as a result of that on the other OSes. This is probably of interest to a few of you, anyway. But still... all of this will be worth it for future works, which I'm already brainstorming.

I've made good progress on the localization framework for the game. I'm kind of building it around an upcoming Japanese localization, which is coming along nicely, and after that I'll explore other languages.

The Official Game Soundtrack is now on [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/3Hq1KifBeB9Ffi1ezJJkOd?si=uVdamCO5RyOzzYQRjgeNqQ]Spotify[/url] in addition to [url=https://chancethrash.bandcamp.com/album/endless-monday-dreams-and-deadlines-ost]Bandcamp[/url]! Support our super cool composer [url=https://chancethrash.bandcamp.com/]Chance Thrash[/url] by checking these out.

There are some new Dreams and Deadlines stickers on my [url=https://shop.hcnone.com]merch shop[/url]! After putting some Endless Monday on your Steam profile, why not put a bit of Endless Monday on your real life stuff? You know you want the "Lumber Lass" and "Log Wild" stickers...

Anyway, I think that's it for now. Thanks for your continued love and support!

notes.title: Thank You!!! And What's Next
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/dd9dd3885956f7f01a670e768a3ca4c9a85522c1.png[/img]
It's been roughly four days since [b]ENDLESS MONDAY: DREAMS AND DEADLINES[/b] release! Whoa, has it really been four days already? I'm pretty sure the launch and response from players has wildly exceeded all my expectations in every way possible, but I'm too tired right now to fully grasp the situation or properly appreciate the magnitude of what's happened. Thank you so much for loving the game! Really! Thank you!! 

Before we get started: [b]The OST is out!![/b] You can check it out [url=https://chancethrash.bandcamp.com/album/endless-monday-dreams-and-deadlines-ost]here[/url], on [url=https://chancethrash.bandcamp.com/music]Chance Thrash's bandcamp page[/url]. Please support the amazing composer of the game's OST. I'll wait!

I (still) haven't been able to get much sleep because I've been busy with the post-launch bug fixes and support and social media posts and stuff. But with today's hotfix out (which I'm hoping should be the last one as far as high priority fixes go), I'm going to try to get some rest for once.

Okay, so, I'm sure you want to know what's next. No? Well I'm telling you anyway.

1. [b]Community Items:[/b] Steam graciously enabled Profile Features for the game, meaning you can now add the game to your profile's various showcases, like for showing off cool achievement icons or your favorite games. This also enabled the Steam "Community Items" (Trading cards and point shop items, etc). So I'm going to work on that and hopefully have them submitted by this week! Please wait warmly!

2.[b] Mac support:[/b] This was planned for release but I didn't have time to finish this before the deadline, so I focused on Windows and SteamDeck instead. But I'll try to get this out as soon as I can, so that Mac gamers and people who want to game on their work laptops can play. Coming soon, hopefully!

3. [b]Localization tooling:[/b] I didn't build in good support for localization because I was too focused on just getting the game out. I figured I'd worry about it when the time came. Well, the time has come... Unsure when this will be done, but after that I can start thinking about non-English translations for the game.

4. [b]Content Updates: [/b] I've been kicking around a lot of ideas in my head for free content updates in the form of short side-stories that take place apart from the game's storyline and other vignettes or minigames. You might see these every once in a while in the coming months. I'm not expecting them to go on forever though, because at some point I'll have to look to the future...

5. [b]Future: [/b] I really want to make more games. I would love the opportunity to make another game, and make this a series and explore more stories in the Endless Monday Video Game Universe. Or just do something completely different. Well it's a little early to be dreaming about this right now, but... anyway...

Also! If you want to support me beyond buying my game (which honestly is already support enough), and you want to put stickers of Tiger-chan or Penny or any of the others on your stuff, I have a merch shop on my website at [url=https://endlessmonday.com]endlessmonday.com[/url]. You can also sign up for a newsletter there too. Or visit my other social media pages. Or whatever.

That's all I have for now. Thanks again, for all your love and support. I'm hoping this is just the beginning! Okay, see you in the next update!
